local_summary: Camarines Sur, Albay, and Catanduanes remain under TCWS No. 3. Destructive storm-force winds and heavy to torrential rains expected in Baao and surrounding Bicol municipalities.
message:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NO. 14
Typhoon #PepitoPH (MAN-YI)
Issued at 8:00 AM, 12 November 2026

'PEPITO' CONTINUES TO THREATEN THE BICOL REGION WITH DESTRUCTIVE TYPHOON-FORCE WINDS AND TORRENTIAL RAINS.

• Location of Eye/Center: 140 km East of Virac, Catanduanes (13.6°N, 125.5°E)
• Maximum Sustained Winds: 165 km/h near the center
• Gustiness: Up to 205 km/h
• Present Movement: Moving West Northwestward at 20 km/h

⚠️ TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNAL (TCWS) NO. 3:
Luzon: Catanduanes, Camarines Sur, Albay, Camarines Norte, eastern portion of Quezon.

⚠️ TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNAL (TCWS) NO. 2:
Luzon: Sorsogon, Masbate, Burias and Ticao Islands, Marinduque, rest of Quezon, Laguna, Rizal.

⚠️ TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNAL (TCWS) NO. 1:
Rest of Bicol Region, Metro Manila, Bulacan, Batangas, Cavite.

DISASTER ADVISORY FOR CAMARINES SUR (BAAO / LAKE BATO BASIN):
Widespread moderate to intense, with at times torrential rains are forecast over Camarines Sur. River flooding and low-lying inundation are expected. Pre-emptive evacuation is strongly advised.

local_summary: Orange Rainfall Warning hoisted for Camarines Sur and Albay. Flooding is threatening along river basins and low-lying agricultural zones of Baao.
message:
HEAVY RAINFALL WARNING NO. 06 #Bicol_PRSD
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 12 November 2026

🟧 ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Camarines Sur (Baao, Nabua, Bula, Iriga City, Pili, Buhi), Albay, and Catanduanes.
• Flooding is threatening in low-lying areas and near river channels.
• Landslides may occur in mountainous slopes.

🟨 YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Sorsogon and Camarines Norte.
• Flooding is possible in flood-prone areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Councils concerned are advised to monitor the weather condition and take appropriate preparedness actions.

local_summary: TCWS No. 2 hoisted over Camarines Sur. Pre-evacuation readiness advised for flood-prone barangays.
message:
TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NO. 11
Severe Tropical Storm #PepitoPH
Issued at 11:00 PM, 11 November 2026

'PEPITO' INTENSIFIES AS IT ACCELERATES CLOSER TO BICOL-SOUTHERN LUZON LANDMASS.

• Location: 280 km East of Daet, Camarines Norte
• Winds: 110 km/h with gusts up to 140 km/h

TCWS No. 2 raised for Camarines Sur, Albay, Catanduanes, Camarines Norte.
Gale warning in effect across eastern seaboards of Luzon and Visayas. Small sea vessels are advised not to venture out to sea.

local_summary: TCWS No. 1 hoisted over Camarines Sur. Residents should inspect roofings, clear drainages, and monitor warnings.
message:
PUBLIC WEATHER FORECAST & TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NO. 08
Tropical Storm #PepitoPH
Issued at 4:00 PM, 11 November 2026

Tropical Storm 'PEPITO' has entered the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).

TCWS NO. 1 is in effect over Bicol Region including Camarines Sur. Strong winds and moderate to heavy rains are likely within the next 36 hours. Disaster management councils are activated.
